name: Martin Gorski
bio: A Representative from Illinois; born in Poland, October 30, 1886; immigrated in 1889 to the United States with his parents, who settled in Chicago, Ill.; attended the public and high schools; was graduated from business college and from Chicago (Ill.) Law School in 1917; was admitted to the bar in 1917 and commenced practice in Chicago, Ill.; assistant State's attorney 1918-1920; master in chancery of the superior court of Cook County, Ill., 1929-1942; elected as a Democrat to the Seventy-eighth and to the three succeeding Congresses; served until his death on December 4, 1949 (January 3, 1943-December 4, 1949); died on December 4, 1949, in Chicago, Ill.; interment at Resurrection Catholic Cemetery, Justice, Ill.
